prompt: Light-background realistic rendered product-style side view of fixed twin tri-star braked courier trolley mid-climb on concrete 170R/280G stairs with cardboard parcel on toe. Vertical 60x40x4 spine centre with folding handle extended up at top showing distinct over-centre folding lock/latch block at H1 hinge on top of spine in locked-open state, separate from plain pivot bolts; MUST NOT render handle as plain pivots only. Show H2 folding toe as separate forward platform with parcel carrying load joined to spine by visible folding hinge pin/bracket with gap; show RIGID weld between spine and star axle. At base twin FIXED triangular R95 side plates rigidly fixed to central spine-star axle at base, each plate carrying 3x 100mm wheels (6 total) bridging two stair nosings; NO vertical swivel stems, NO caster forks. Render one-way clutch as small 30x62x16mm steel cylinder coaxial ON the star axle side, directly adjacent to deadman disc, clearly visible; NOT a spring, bracket, or hidden internals. Exposed perforated deadman disc adjacent to clutch on same axle. Draw ONE thin anchored force-path arrow: start ON toe platform -> up spine -> into star axle -> to stair contact, plus ONE short curved braking arrow FROM clutch body edge INTO disc edge; all arrows must touch source and sink parts; NO floating/off-part blue/red decorative arrows; if cannot anchor, draw no arrows. Draw in-image short callouts with leader lines and dots: 'twin fixed tri-stars' anchor dot ONLY on star triangular plate, never on toe plate; 'spine' on spine pole; 'wheels' on 100mm wheel; 'one-way clutch' on coaxial cylinder; 'deadman disc' on disc; 'folding toe' on toe platform hinge; 'stainless lock' on lock block. No dimensions, no values, no footer, no scale bar in image.
must_not: swivel casters or vertical swivel stems or caster forks
spring or bracket or hidden internals instead of coaxial clutch cylinder
plain pivot bolts only for handle without lock block
leader for twin fixed tri-stars on toe plate
changes_from_previous: Full regeneration from caster failure: replaced swivel casters with FIXED triangular R95 plates on fixed spine-star axle, added coaxial CSK30 cylinder + R60 disc form, added visible H1/H2 folding hinges + DESTACO over-centre lock block, re-anchored twin fixed tri-stars leader to star plate only, replaced floating arrows with anchored force/brake path.

visual_plan.view: side view eye-level full-profile showing fixed spine-star axle versus folding H1/H2 hinges
visual_plan.spatial_layout: side profile, light wall background, concrete stairs right; vertical spine centre, top H1 handle up with lock block, mid H2 toe forward with parcel, base twin triangular star plates straddling two nosings with 6 wheels, clutch cylinder + disc exposed on side of star axle
visual_plan.operating_moment: mid-climb braked hold on 170R/280G stairs with two-nosing contact, parcel box present on extended H2 toe, handle pulled up, clutch holding and disc metering descent
visual_plan.transfer_path: Force: H2 toe -> spine -> R95 tri-stars to stairs | Measured/Braking: CSK30 clutch -> R60 disc
visual_plan.interactions: H2 toe hinge-folded to spine carries parcel; spine rigidly welded/keyed to central star axle; star plates fixed to axle carry 3 wheels each rolling on two nosings; CSK30 cylinder coaxial on axle holds then feeds to adjacent R60 disc for metering; DESTACO lock block locks H1 hinge open and H2 hinge; force flows toe->spine->stars->stairs, braking CSK->disc.
avoid: swivel casters, swivel stems, caster forks
spring/bracket clutch, hidden clutch, trailing disc-arm
fused toe without hinge gap, plain handle pivots

focus_parts.purpose: carry bending moment vertical fixed to star axle
roll and climb with star on nosings
hold 38.5Nm no slip coaxial on star axle
lock H1/H2 open latched against vibration
